# GmplySS89

Named action/condition handler over GameplayScreenSizeC89. It remains independent of Blank3D and of rendering/window APIs.

Actions: camera_size_draw, scene_screen_size, camera_screen_pos, camera_screen_clamp, gameplay_screen_apply.

Conditions: camera_fits_scene, camera_clamped, camera_clamp_enabled.

Protocol89: ISO C89, no heap, no float/double, no explicit 64-bit types.
